snapshot.purpose: Immutable source snapshot for UIOWA-101 command/path verification. Later main changes require an explicit catalog refresh; they are not silently absorbed.

status_semantics.working: Executable source exists at the recorded blob SHA; command contract was checked against that source and a synthetic/source-backed sample result is recorded.
status_semantics.static: Useful published machine-readable reference with no executable entry point.
status_semantics.template: Useful published worksheet/document bundle with no executable entry point.
status_semantics.incomplete: Published material advertises or implies an entry point that is absent or not usable in this snapshot.

caveats: This catalog verifies source/path/command contracts and recorded sample evidence; it does not claim every command was re-executed by the catalog builder.
Synthetic/provider-readback results are not University of Iowa findings.
A working status is version-bound. Run verify_catalog.py after pulling a newer revision; blob drift is reported rather than silently accepted.

entries.title: Local analyst workbench
entries.supported_input: Loopback HTTP UI; synthetic candidate + authority JSON submitted to the local inspection endpoint.
entries.produced_output: Local-only browser workbench and non-authorizing inspection report.

entries.title: Non-authorizing workshare compiler CLI
